subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class shell-facing admin notification command and Gateway/UI event, or should this request be folded into the broader WebUI notification architecture?
rationale: The requested path crosses CLI public API, Gateway admin authorization, connected UI rendering, and security review, while current main only has adjacent Web Push/system-event surfaces.

options.title: Design core admin notify contract
options.body: Add a typed admin-scoped Gateway method/event plus CLI and Control UI renderer with explicit auth, targeting, payload, rate-limit, docs, and tests.

options.title: Fold into broader notification tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as input but make the broader WebUI notification tracker own the UI/toast design and security model first.

options.title: Decline core surface
options.body: Route shell alerts to existing external/plugin/workaround paths if maintainers do not want a core admin-to-UI interruption API.

recommendation.title: Design core admin notify contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed admin-scoped Gateway method/event plus CLI and Control UI renderer with explicit auth, targeting, payload, rate-limit, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Control UI and Gateway history makes this the best available routing candidate for the product/API boundary decision.
